lines: bellhop's Claude relay is an MCP server, `bellhop _relay`. It listens on <runtime_dir>/claude-<pid>.sock and delivers through Claude's own messaging socket.
install for every session: claude mcp add --scope user bellhop -- bellhop _relay
or for one run: claude --mcp-config <exported dir>/bellhop-mcp.json -- <prompt> (end the --mcp-config list before a prompt)
bellhop must be on the PATH Claude starts MCP servers with; a running session keeps the relay it started with until it is restarted.
